note: The PD 1.9 sprites face the side (right; left is the mirror). Part 8 adds the front (walking towards the camera, down the screen) and the back (away from it, up the screen). The side stays as it is; diagonals are shown from the side.

rule.move: the step from cell (x0, y0) to (x1, y1): dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0 (y grows down the screen, towards the camera). dx != 0: side, flipped when dx < 0 (as now). dx == 0 and dy > 0: front. dx == 0 and dy < 0: back.
rule.act: an attack, a zap, a throw: the same rule for the step towards the target
rule.stand: standing keeps the last facing; a hero who has not moved yet (a new level, a load) faces front
rule.hold: a facing holds at least 120 ms (one step at 20 fps), so a zigzag of one-cell steps does not flicker
rule.dead: die (frames 8-12) is the tomb, the same picture in every facing

layout.same: every facing sheet has the layout of the class sheet: the same frame numbers, the same armour rows

pose.front: head: PD's own front head (frames 16-17 look down at the hands: what a 70-degree camera sees); body: the side sheet's, which PD draws square to the viewer. run: the legs lift in turn (1-2 px), the arm opposite swings, the body rises mid-stride. attack: 13 the right fist up by the head, 14 it comes at the camera over the belly (the body a pixel forward), 15 back. operate 16-17 and read 19 are PD's own; read 20 holds the scroll open across the chest.
pose.back: head: the back of the head drawn over the outline of the front head in the class's hair (the rogue's hood, the huntress's braid). body: the armour without its front (buckles, lights, the shirt's V take the torso's colour). attack: the arm up over the shoulder (13), forward out of sight with the body a pixel away (14). operate and read: the hands in front, unseen, the elbows out.
pose.weapon: PD 1.9 draws no weapon in the hero's hand: the blow is the arm and the fist. The facings keep that.

looks.build: part 5's own recolour (tools/art/firelight/p5/looks.py) run on the facing sheets

legendary.aura: mart/fl/legendary/<cls>-<id>-aura.png: the same in every facing (sparks around the figure)

hats.rule: as on the side: the same frame and armour row as the hero, the cell at hero origin - heroAt; fitted by part 5's hats.py on each facing's frames
hats.back: from behind: no tricorn cockade, no stargazer's star; the eyepatch is its strap and knot; the rest is the hat seen from behind

slime.note: the part 5 picture faces the camera: front = side

bat.note: the part 5 picture faces the camera: front = side

skull.note: the part 5 picture faces the camera: front = side

ember.note: the part 5 picture faces the camera: front = side

pets.rule: the pet takes the facing of its own step behind the hero (the same rule); a symmetric pet has one sheet

mobs.rule: as for the heroes: the step's dx != 0 -> side (flipped when dx < 0), dy > 0 -> front, dy < 0 -> back; standing keeps the last facing; a new monster faces side (as PD draws it) until it moves; an attack turns it to the target; the facing holds at least 120 ms; die frames are the same picture in every facing
mobs.fallback: a kind without a facing sheet (stage 3, the symmetric ones) is drawn from the side in every facing

fetidRat.note: PD draws the fetid rat with the rat's sheet: so do its facings (the stench is the game's own effect)

pose.gnoll: the hyena head turned to the camera (ears up, the muzzle and its black nose at the camera) on PD's body; from behind the mane down the nape, the fur without its light chest
pose.shaman: the red mask across the eyes, the pale muzzle under it; from behind the mask's strap over the fur
pose.skeleton: the skull square to the camera, the sockets either side of the middle; from behind the round back of the skull, the spine and the shoulder blades. Idle 1-3 is PD's skull spinning round, the other way round from behind
pose.thief: the face in the middle of the hood, the hands holding the loot at the chest; from behind the hood and the cloak. The stab: the blade comes out of the hands at the camera
pose.rat: sitting up, the snout at the camera, ears either side, the paws at the chest, the tail curling out; from behind the backs of the ears and the tail between the feet. The bite lunges a pixel at the camera (away from it from behind); the run hops
pose.bee: the camera looks down on the bee: coming at it, the head and eyes are nearest, the striped abdomen rises behind between the wings; going away, the abdomen and its sting are nearest. The wings stay see-through and flap; PD's own height over the shadow
pose.sheep: PD's face (drawn frontal at the right edge of the wool) in the middle of the fleece, chewing as in PD's idle frames; from behind the fleece and a white tail that wags
pose.spinner: already faces the camera: the front is the side; the back is the same picture without the eyes
pose.bat: already faces the camera: the front is the side; the back is the same picture without the red eyes and mouth
pose.variants: the rat and thief views in the colours of PD's second row (the palette PD swaps between the rows)
pose.humanoids: PD draws the body square to the viewer and turns only the head, so the front is a front head in the sheet's own palette on the side body. Walking lifts the legs in turn; the blow comes a pixel at the camera, or away from it from behind
pose.die: as in PD: the body falling is the same picture from every side

symmetric.note: drawn facing the camera or round: the same from every side, no new views
